messages:
Maya (CS Ops): quick flag 10: noticed a batch reassign from the stale-owner job bumped a bunch of mid-MRR accounts to unassigned. owners got notifications and some accounts churned contact attempts.
Ethan (CRM): yikes. which job run? i see a scheduled run at 03:00 that touched ~420 accounts.
Maya (CS Ops): run id stale-reassign-170999. majority were >90 days no-touch but several had recent support tickets.
Zoe (Data): shared query: i grouped reassigns by last_ticket_ts and found ~12% had recent tickets (<14d).
Sam (Enablement): that's bad. automated reassign should exclude accounts with recent support or onboarding activity.
Ethan (CRM): agreed. quick mitigation: add a safelist rule to the job to skip accounts with last_support_ts >= now() - interval '14 days' and any account with active playbook locks.
playbook-bot: created job patch cp-stale-170999  status: queued. (/jobs/patch cp-stale-170999) :gear:
Maya (CS Ops): pref sample-run first — pause reassign for 25% of affected accounts, tag them "hold:stale-reassign" and notify owners to confirm. reduces churn risk while we patch.
Zoe (Data): sampling done. CSV uploaded: /shared/cs/stale-sample-170999.csv. sample shows similar 12% recent-support overlap.
Ethan (CRM): pushing mapping change to staging: add check skip_if recent_support OR playbook_lock. will feature-flag in prod after smoke.
Sam (Enablement): i can draft a 1-line owner notification: "We detected an automated reassignment that may affect your book. Please confirm ownership or mark as protected."
Maya (CS Ops): perfect. playbook-bot, can you enact the 25% hold and add tags?
playbook-bot: cp-stale-170999 moved to in-progress  safeguard applied to sampled cohort. :white_check_mark:
Maya (CS Ops): next steps: Ethan deploys patch behind flag, Zoe monitors reassign rate metric, Sam readies owner comms, and i'll run triage on the sampled accounts tomorrow 9am. will update thread when complete.
